results.name: Japanese Restaurant : kokoro Ramen
results.description:
This 3D model represents a small Japanese ramen restaurant with detailed craftsmanship. The exterior features a blue awning, traditional windows, and signs with Japanese inscriptions. Outside, stools are available for customers, and a sign displays the menu.

Inside, the counter is decorated with bowls, chopsticks, napkins, and other small details that enhance the scene's realism. These elements bring life and authenticity to the ramen restaurant.

The minimalist architecture and design make it perfect for video game projects, virtual reality, or stylized environments.

Modeled in Maya 2023, it integrates easily into various projects, such as animations or interactive scenes.

results.name: Small Cafe
results.description:
Small modern cafe which I made for a university assignment. All the textures are baked!

Despite its compact size, the cafe is fully functional, with a counter at the entrance where your people can order their coffee or food. There's a small seating area with tables and chairs, making it a great place for your players to take a break and refuel. The space is well-lit with large windows, showcasing vibrant textures.

results.name: Modern Coffee Shop Interior - Sweet Spot Cafe

Designed with a clean, illustrative outline aesthetic, this asset is perfect for arch-viz, lifestyle simulations, or stylized game environments.

results.name: train station
results.description: A train station is a facility where trains stop to pick up and drop off passengers and/or goods. It typically includes at least one platform and a station building with amenities like ticket counters, waiting rooms, and sometimes shops or restaurants. Stations can range from small halts to large, busy terminals, and are essential hubs for rail transport that connect different locations.
